svg.title: 2015 West Hawaiʻi mapped reef heat exposure
svg.desc: Annual maximum Degree Heating Weeks on existing NAD83 UTM zone 5N grid. Of 330 cells, 51 contain mapped historical reef or hardbottom and receive class fills. Diagonal hatching means no valid DHW, not low exposure. No basemap or inferred coastline. Grid north points up; scale bar is 20 kilometres in projected map units.
